en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al-Husayn, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ismail Bin Abu Sara who said, 
‘Aban Bin Taghlub informed me saying, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>,
‘During which time did Rasool-Allahsaww pray Al-Witr (Salāt)?’ So heasws said: ‘Upon the like of the setting of the sun up to Al-Maghrib Salāt’.
en.sarwar: 24. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Al-Husayn ibn abu ‘Umayr from ’Isma‘il ibn abu Sarah from Aban ibn Taghlib who has said the following: “I once asked abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
’What time did the Messenger of Allah perform al- Witr?’ He (the Imam) said, ’Within a time like from sunset to al-Maghrib Salah (prayer).’”
